result: The new column should be named 'fsi'. The formula for calculating the Financial Stability Index (FSI) is: 0.3 * (1 - debincratio) + 0.3 * (liqassets / (mthincome * 6)) + 0.2 * (bankaccbal / (mthincome * 3)) + 0.2 * (savamount / (mthincome * 12)). This formula uses the debt-to-income ratio, liquid assets, monthly income, bank account balance, and savings amount.

args.sql:
ALTER TABLE employment_and_income ADD COLUMN fsi numeric;

DO $$
DECLARE
    rec RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR rec IN 
        SELECT e.emplcoreref, e.debincratio, e.mthincome,
               ex.liqassets, ex.savamount,
               b.bankaccbal
        FROM employment_and_income e
        JOIN expenses_and_assets ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref
        JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON ex.expemplref = b.bankexpref
        WHERE e.mthincome > 0
    LOOP
        UPDATE employment_and_income
        SET fsi = 0.3 * (1 - rec.debincratio) 
              + 0.3 * (rec.liqassets / (rec.mthincome * 6))
              + 0.2 * (rec.bankaccbal / (rec.mthincome * 3))
              + 0.2 * (rec.savamount / (rec.mthincome * 12))
        WHERE emplcoreref = rec.emplcoreref;
    END LOOP;
END $$;
